summary: You pick one track: Arabic (24 units), Hebrew (32), African Languages, Literatures and Cultures (32), Persian (30) or Turkish (30). The audit checks the track's unit total, its language courses (Arabic from the list, the others by language subject, with three courses in one African language) and the Persian or Turkish COMPLIT units, at least six courses in all, with every course letter graded and a C or better. Checked by hand: the faculty director approves all courses, six of them are 3 units or more, the Hebrew and African literature and culture units (one course in COMPLIT), which you move in, a sequence in an African language Stanford lists under another subject, and the Oral Proficiency Interview. Up to 5 units of transfer credit may count with the director's approval, and units may not also count toward another major or minor.
